Name: Soup's SquareSoft Sewer
Author: SuperElement
Description:
Soup's SquareSoft Sewer 1.0.0
_______________________________________________

Description:

This is a simple re-skin of the sewer palette to look like something out of a SquareSoft RPG.

Content Patcher version, which makes it easy to install and un-install.
A map edit of the sewer is included in order to compensate for a couple of oversights.

Enjoy!

_______________________________________________

Install:

Drop the SoupsSquareSoftSewer folder from the .7z into your mods folder and start the game.

_______________________________________________

Un-install:

Simply delete the SoupsSquareSoftSewer folder from your mods folder. This will completely remove any changes that
this mod makes.

_______________________________________________

Required Mods:

SMAPI:
[url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io/[/url]

Content Patcher:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url]

Also, 7z is required for opening the archive in the download:
[url=https://www.7-zip.org/download.html]https://www.7-zip.org/download.html[/url]
_______________________________________________

Usage:

Simply enter the sewers in the game to witness the change.

_______________________________________________

Troubleshooting:

If you have any issues, submit a post either on the Nexus Page or discussion thread on the Chucklefish
forums.
